title: Margaret Jane Mowbray
dates: (1858-1926)
---

headmistress of Winchester High School

She was one of many women signatories to a pro-suffrage article, ‘Women’s Suffrage: A Reply’ Fortnightly Review 46 (July 1889) 123-40.

Her obituary (The Times 15 September 1926) states that she was headmistress 1885-1916.
